name: Fantasy Football Draft Assistant MVP
description: Manual draft-room assistant: paste drafted players after each real pick, filter the available pool, calculate roster needs, recommend the next best picks, and export the draft board to Excel.

nodes.name: Manual Draft Update
nodes.notes: Run this after each group of real draft picks. Paste the latest drafted player names into the script node.

nodes.name: Paste Picks Draft Advisor
nodes.notes: MVP mode: manually paste drafted players and your roster. The script removes drafted players and recommends the best available options.

nodes.name: Recommendation Table
nodes.notes: Turn recommendations into a clean draft table with player, position, projected points, score, and reason.

nodes.name: Export Draft Excel
nodes.notes: Export the recommendation table to an Excel draft sheet for quick review during the league draft.

nodes.name: Available Player Pool
nodes.notes: Optional full available-player table. Use this when you want to inspect all remaining players, not only the top recommendations.

nodes.name: Write Draft Log
nodes.notes: Record pick number, drafted count, and recommendation count for the draft session.

nodes.name: Text Draft Recommendation
nodes.notes: Send compact fantasy draft recommendations by Gmail and T-Mobile SMS gateway recipients.

integrationSettings.bodyTemplate: Fantasy pick #{{pick_number}}: 1) {{recommendations.0.player}} {{recommendations.0.position}} {{recommendations.0.team}}; 2) {{recommendations.1.player}} {{recommendations.1.position}}; 3) {{recommendations.2.player}} {{recommendations.2.position}}. Need: RB {{roster_needs.1.need}}, WR {{roster_needs.2.need}}, QB {{roster_needs.0.need}}, TE {{roster_needs.3.need}}.
